name: @yunari/renderer-core
description: Shared renderer used by both the editor and the display-only player.
//: IMPORTANT: this package must never depend on editor UI, inspectors or a component framework. §47 requires the display-only bundle to exclude all of that, and a dependency here would pull it in. Editor-only behaviour belongs in @yunari/editor. It must also stay FABRIC-FREE: the host imports runtime values from this package's barrel and runs in Node, so a Fabric import reachable from here would put a browser scene graph in the host bundle. Fabric lives in @yunari/scene-fabric, which the host does not depend on.
